Engineering team uses Node.js SDK and a mix of cron jobs for nightly vector indexing.

Latency target for chat: p95 < 300ms for simple FAQ replies; willing to accept 600ms for long-form summaries. Throughput: 40 qps peak during flash sales.

Security: public cloud only for now; needs SOC2 attestation and SSO/SAML for enterprise customers in roadmap. Requested audit logs and retention controls for compliance gate.
